summary: 2026-08-03 10:15:37 PDT — The branch adds the requested positive prompt pins, and reviewer_test.sh passes 64/64 checks. However, it violates the append-only plan contract by rewriting the retracted row in place, and its OPS-18 ownership pin still omits the separate BACKLOG.md handoff site.

findings.title: Retracted plan row is edited in place
findings.claim: The diff rewrites the previously recorded AC5 replacement row into a struck-through, annotated row. AC4 explicitly requires approved rows to remain unchanged and says post-approval corrections must be represented through the amendment log; the adjacent retraction entry does not make this in-place edit permissible. This destroys the append-only evidence and also places a retracted row under the “Active replacement rows” heading.
findings.suggestion: Restore the prior row byte-for-byte. Preserve the appended retract/add entries, and append the replacement row separately so active state is derived without modifying the historical row.

findings.title: BACKLOG handoff remains unpinned
findings.claim: The new OPS-18 ownership assertion searches only `$FRAME`. AC7 identifies BACKLOG.md as a separate edit site carrying the handoff that the minimal fix depends on, but deleting its OPS-18 ownership and “go unreviewed” warning would leave this linter green. AC6 therefore still does not pin the load-bearing phrase at each edit site.
findings.suggestion: Define the BACKLOG.md path and add a positive assertion for its amendment-review ownership and unreviewed-until-OPS-18 warning, then demonstrate that deleting that text makes the check fail.
